items:
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.
Circuit breaker is opened and racked out
Change remote / local control switch to local position
Clean the mating surface of the metal clad

Check the racking mechanism to make certain that it is in the disconnect 
 position

Check the voltage control at source of power and line drop between the power 
 source and breaker
Check the safety shutter inside the cubical slide freely
Clean lubricate grease and penetrating spray for breaker operating mechanism
Check the operating handle of the CB and the power plug operating device

Check the electrical operation using test cabinet (if available) or the test 
 position in the metal clad switchgear

Examine the movable contact rod of the vacuum interrupter with the breaker open 
 and wipe the lubricant off the rod
